description: Trait de côte d'Estérel Côte d'Azur Agglomération is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Estérel Côte d'Azur Agglomération. GPS survey of the coastal line of Estérel Côte d'Azur Agglomeration - Formerly called CAVEM. Quarterly survey, (March, June, September, December) since September 2011 (241 items exported). Coverage: Estérel Côte d'Azur Agglomération. The portal shows the English title as "Coast of Estérel Côte d'Azur Agglomeration" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Estérel Côte d'Azur Agglomération. Its keywords include littoral, lineaire, trait-de-cote, suivi-scientifique, gps, coordonnee. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
